adopted_design: Readable pull state records started, pulling and pullAgain so start settles before pulling, one pull runs at a time, and concurrent demand triggers one recheck. Readable phase remains the terminal authority; queues and pending reads remain FIFO data. Writable sink calls route through one operation boundary that turns synchronous throws and promise rejections into stream errors. Node stream finished retains its documented returned-cleanup behavior while cleanup remains effective after settlement; addAbortSignal delegates completion to finished's stream-side observation instead of treating any one Duplex event as terminal. stream/promises is projected from the shared stream module so require aliases reuse the same functions and state.
